'''Zarik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed in [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], selling weaponry in [[Dorn Base]].
